purpose: Add a bounded quantitative aggregate structural-functional proxy from already-published normalized IODA charts without substituting for raw historical BGP route-state reconstruction.

digitization.per_x_rule: median y coordinate of exact line-color pixels inside plot area
digitization.window_statistics: mean, median, min, max of digitized x-column values

primary_descriptive_window.name: acute_event
primary_descriptive_window.reason: Uses the independently reported significant-disruption onset rather than choosing the lowest visual segment.

integrity_limits: Approximate values digitized from a rasterized normalized chart; they are not original IODA samples.
Do not label BGP chart retention as PVR, ROR, USF, or route-level survival.
Do not use these values to fit hidden route-level parameters.
Raw RIS/RouteViews historical reconstruction remains required for route-level structural claims.

baseline_window.reason: Pre-event plot segment used for the released signal-family medians.

sensitivity_analysis.purpose: Quantify robustness of the plot-derived divergence to window, axis-calibration, RGB-tolerance, and statistic perturbations.

third_party_material_note: Original IODA plot images are not redistributed in Online Resource 1. Pixel-level reruns require independently obtaining the corresponding source plots from IODA.
